_about: Hand-curated links from the OctoWoW shop's skin tokens (item ids from the client's item cache) to the client's skin textures. The client does not say which token applies which texture (the server does), so every link records its basis and how sure it is. basis: 'name' = the texture file name and the token name agree; 'ordinal' = numbered series match in order (Wildhammer I-IV, wildhammershop1-4); 'visual' = compared by eye with the shop's own picture of that token (skin colour, marks, eye glow). confidence: 'high' = no other texture of the race looks like the picture; 'medium' = the best match, with one look-alike or a weaker sex; 'low' = several textures look the same as the picture and this is one of them. A link is evidence, not proof. Paths are client paths with forward slashes, matched case-insensitively. 'm' and 'f' are the male and female texture; 'alternates' are look-alike textures. When both a baked 'shop' texture and a CharSections row look the same, the baked shop texture is preferred. Tokens absent from this list (50223, 61106) have no texture that matches their picture. 'checked' = the date the skin's render in the real viewer was compared with the shop picture by eye (all linked tokens; not in game).
